title: Dolphin eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dolphin body -->
  <path d='M15,55 Q20,35 45,32 Q65,30 78,40 Q88,48 85,58 Q82,68 70,68 Q55,68 45,62 Q35,58 28,60 Q20,62 15,55 Z' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- dolphin belly highlight -->
  <path d='M30,58 Q45,64 62,64 Q72,64 78,58 Q74,66 62,66 Q46,66 30,58 Z' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <!-- dolphin dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M48,33 Q52,18 60,26 Q56,32 52,34 Z' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <!-- dolphin tail upper -->
  <path d='M14,54 Q4,42 8,34 Q16,40 18,48 Z' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <!-- dolphin tail lower -->
  <path d='M14,56 Q2,62 6,72 Q15,64 17,58 Z' fill='#0298D8'/>

  <circle cx='68' cy='46' r='3.2' fill='#0D47A1'/>
  <circle cx='69.2' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#E1F5FE'/>

  <path d='M75,52 Q80,56 84,52' stroke='#0277BD' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack (fish) in mouth -->
  <path d='M82,50 Q92,45 96,50 Q92,55 82,52 Z' fill='#FFB74D'/>
  <!-- fish tail -->
  <path d='M95,50 L98,44 L98,56 Z' fill='#FF9800'/>
  <!-- fish eye -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='50' r='1.3' fill='#4E342E'/>
  <!-- little bubbles -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='38' r='2' fill='#E1F5FE' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='34' r='1.4' fill='#E1F5FE' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- water sparkle -->
  <path d='M25,70 Q30,65 35,70' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
